x: Starring Jean Manning, who was cashiered from the WRENS after mistaking the Commander's order to "Get out his pinnace". 3.30 THE NEWCOMERS or DON'T ASK US WE'RE NEW HERE with Mell Ford, Glyn Ratcliffe and Steve Inman

For a change, we supplied a few winners namely Glyn Ratcliffe in the Senior shot, Steve Inman in the junior javelin, Martin Bloice and Richard Langley in the youth's quarter and half respectively, as well as the 2 mile team, the senior and youths relay teams.
Mel Ford (400m Hurdles, 4X400m Relay) also posted to Ireland. Steve Inman (Pole Vault) also posted to Ireland. Charlie Gillett (400m Hurdles, 4 X 440 Relay) Injured.
Nick Head is back in the country again and is already finding form with the Javelin, with Steve Inman close on his heels. This partnership has already given us maximum points in the Malkin Trophy.
Also stationed at Caterham with Mel are Glyn Ratcliffe, Steve Inman and Keith Schofield. I hope that guard duties will not eliminate them from the League meetings.
